10k.note: Primary disclosure is Lucid Diagnostics commercial diagnostic (EsoGuard / EsoCheck) and Veris Health digital cancer-care platform; no proprietary drug pipeline.

website.note: Corporate site emphasizes subsidiaries Lucid Diagnostics (EsoGuard) and Veris Health (cancer-care platform). No drug or pivotal device P1-P3 trials disclosed on landing pages.

ctgov.note: No company-sponsored interventional Phase 1-3 trials kept after filtering.

EsoGuard.indication: Detection of Barrett's esophagus and esophageal adenocarcinoma in at-risk GERD patients
EsoGuard.regulatory_status: Commercialized as LDT under CLIA; FDA Breakthrough Device Designation (Feb 2020) as IVD; CE Mark self-certified (IVDD)
EsoGuard.evidence_activities: Real-world ~12,000-patient experience under journal review; PREVENT and PREVENT-FF observational registries ongoing

EsoCheck.type: Swallowable balloon-capsule esophageal cell collection device
EsoCheck.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared (2019, expanded 2022 to pediatric); CE Mark certified

Veris_Cancer_Care_Platform.type: Digital cancer-care platform (Non-Device Clinical Decision Software, FDA-excluded)
Veris_Cancer_Care_Platform.status: Commercial; OSUCCC - The James commercial-phase partnership launched Oct 2025

Implantable_Physiologic_Monitor.type: Implantable monitor designed to interface with vascular access port
Implantable_Physiologic_Monitor.status: In development; 510(k) submission planned as early as late 2026 — NOT yet in active pivotal P1-P3 trial

excluded_preclinical.reason: Pre-submission/development stage; 510(k) targeted for late 2026 — no active pivotal clinical study disclosed.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical-device / molecular-diagnostics holding company. Commercial-stage assets (EsoGuard/EsoCheck via Lucid Diagnostics; Veris Cancer Care Platform via Veris Health) plus a pre-submission implantable monitor. No proprietary drug or active pivotal device P1/P2/P3 clinical pipeline; ongoing PREVENT registries are observational, not interventional Phase 1-3 studies.
